intent: Turn off the Hermes cron scheduler (all four PSI-096 standing jobs) and block cron-connected tasks: recurring background jobs caused system instability.
summary: Operator reported the Hermes cron scheduler (the PSI-096 standing jobs) caused system errors on the host. Priority action taken: all four cron jobs paused atomically via cronjob_manage action=pause (a3e9af9d79b3 morning pulse, e9cc298252ab contract check, 52d300adad2c weekly graph, 11b42f15a1e6 stale work) — each now state=paused, enabled=false, no scheduled fire. The scheduler's next-run timestamps still display but paused jobs do not fire; contract check's manual smoke-test fire from earlier (15:01 WIB) was delivered ok, and its 22:00 WIB schedule is cancelled. PSI-096 moved to blocked pending operator triage; PSI-077 (Daily digest) also carries a cron-scheduler note (its own pg_cron dependency is app-level and unrelated to the Hermes scheduler). No code was changed; commits for the scheduler setup (PR #58) are merged on master but the jobs themselves live in the Hermes scheduler store and remain paused (not deleted) so they can be re-enabled after triage.

changes.note: 4 jobs paused (enabled=false): morning pulse, contract check, weekly graph, stale work
PSI-096 status doing -> blocked with reason + blocked-date

decisions.decision: Pause (not delete) all four cron jobs
decisions.reason: Pause preserves job definitions so they can be re-enabled after operator triage; delete would lose the schedule + prompts. Paused jobs do not fire.

decisions.decision: PSI-096 -> blocked with explicit reason (C-15 human gate)
decisions.reason: Requires operator decision on whether/how to re-run the standing jobs; a needs-decision card is Blocked, not Review.

decisions.decision: PSI-077 noted but left status unchanged (already blocked on PSI-098)
decisions.reason: PSI-077 uses app-level pg_cron (Supabase Postgres), not the Hermes scheduler; it is already blocked, so no status change needed — only a clarifying note.

verification.manual: hermes cron list shows all 4 jobs [paused]; agent:check validates the docs change.

human_review.reason: Operator must decide how to re-enable standing jobs without destabilizing the host.

follow_ups.note: Operator triage: re-enable via cronjob_manage action=resume per job, or harden the jobs (e.g. lower frequency, pin model, restrict concurrent runs) before resuming.
